profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Amazon | CS @ Michigan
profile.summary: As an experienced Software Engineer, I specialize in designing and delivering scalable, distributed systems, with a strong enthusiasm for high-performance computing and machine learning. Proficient in Java, C++, Python, and AWS Cloud Services, I am eager to apply my expertise to innovative projects at leading technology firms.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Led the design and implementation of a REST API-based storage solution for extensive compliance metadata and machine learning outputs.
• Developed a highly scalable and containerized microservice using Spring Framework, leveraging AWS Elastic Container Service for seamless deployment and orchestration.
• Collaborated across multiple teams and stakeholders to refine requirements, resolve ambiguities, and reach alignment on the needs for a newly developing system.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Implemented an AI-based batch translation orchestrator, saving Amazon millions in translation costs and extending product availability to tens more marketplaces.
• Delved deep into legal and security policies to address security vulnerabilities in legacy systems, delivering both immediate and long-term solutions.

positions.title: Course Assistant
positions.description:
• Graded assignments and provided tutoring for Math 217 (Linear Algebra) and EECS 370 (Computer
Organization), assisting students in understanding complex topics and proofs.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Spearheaded a research subgroup to design, implement, and train reinforcement learning (RL)
agents, achieving a state-of-the-art adversarial RL agent while reducing training costs by 75%.
• Collaborated in a research group to develop a C++ program generating meshes of proteins and cell
membranes, supporting advanced ion channel research.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
• Engineered a Java system to process and back-fill millions of documents, achieving a rate of 20 documents per second during a critical document migration.
• Proficiently utilized AWS services like EC2, S3, and DynamoDB for dynamic data operations and system scalability.

positions.title: Front Desk Staff
positions.description:
• Communicated with students and parents to resolve housing-related problems and questions
• Assisted with housing placements and MCard printing in order to ensure a smooth transition to the University for incoming undergraduate and graduate students

projects.title: Snake Algorithms
projects.description:
- Used object oriented programming in python with the Pygame module in order to build a Snake game which can be played by humans or by various algorithms
- Implemented a shortest path, BFS, and a genetic evolving Neural Network in order to study each algorithm’s advantages and disadvantages for playing the game Snake

projects.title: Magnetic-Shielding Simulations
projects.description:
-Used Numpy tools to simulate magnetic fields in cylinder and box magnets in order to determine the magnetic shielding properties of current-carrying wires
-Used Matplotlib in Jupyter Notebook to create visualizations of H and B-fields in order to gain a better understanding of the effects of conductor symmetry and wire count on magnetic shielding processes
